title: Four Ways to Grow a Classifier and Why One of Them Cannot Learn
abstract: arXiv:2610.00180v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Constructive classifiers add structure while they train: a level to a tree, a unit to a hidden layer, a split at a leaf. This paper asks what each of four such growth decisions actually buys, measured under one fixed protocol in tree-structured and constructive models, and gives an exact diagnosis and a fix for the one that buys nothing.   The diagnosis concerns the most natural way to deepen a soft decision tree: turn every leaf into a gate whose two children inherit the parent's class distribution, so that the function is unchanged. I prove that this leaves the gradient of every new gate identically zero and, with the gate at 1/2, gives the two children identical gradients, so the added level can never learn. Unlike the symmetry that Net2Net breaks with noise or the saddle point that splitting steepest descent escapes with second-order information, first-order information here is not weak but absent. translated_title: 分类器的四种生长方式，以及为什么其中一种无法学习
translated_abstract: 构造式分类器在训练过程中不断增加结构：给树增加一层、给隐藏层增加一个单元、在叶节点处进行分裂。本文探讨了这四种生长决策各自真正带来了什么收益，在树结构和构造式模型上采用统一的固定协议进行测量，并对其中毫无收益的一种给出了精确的诊断和修复方案。该诊断针对的是加深软决策树最自然的方式：将每个叶节点变成一个门控，其两个子节点继承父节点的类别分布，从而使函数保持不变。我证明这种做法会使每个新门控的梯度恒为零，并且当门控取值为1/2时，两个子节点获得完全相同的梯度，因此新增的层级永远无法学习。与Net2Net用噪声打破的对称性不同，也与最速下降分裂依靠二阶信息逃脱的鞍点不同，这里的一阶信息并非微弱，而是完全缺失。在三次随机种子的五折交叉验证上……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文在统一协议下评估了构造式分类器的四种生长决策，并证明软决策树最自然的加深方式——将叶节点分裂为继承父节点类别分布的门控——会使新门控梯度恒为零、两个子节点梯度完全相同，导致新增层级永远无法学习，同时给出了精确诊断与修复方案。
en_tdlr: This paper evaluates four growth decisions in constructive classifiers under a fixed protocol and proves that the most natural way to deepen a soft decision tree—turning leaves into gates whose children inherit the parent's class distribution—leaves every new gate with identically zero gradients and gives its two children identical gradients, so the added level can never learn.
